disclaimer: Simplified estimate for Indonesian tax-resident individuals. PTKP (non-taxable income) applied as standard deduction for single individual. Married/dependent PTKP adjustments, social security (BPJS), and occupational expense deduction (5% of gross, max Rp6,000,000) are not included.

regimes.label: Resident Individual — Single (2024)
regimes.notes: PTKP for single individual (TK/0) of Rp54,000,000 applied as standard deduction. Married or with dependents gets higher PTKP not reflected here.

regimes.label: Non-Resident
regimes.notes: Non-resident individuals are taxed at a flat 20% on gross Indonesia-source income, with no standard deduction or progressive slabs.

residency_threshold_note: ADVISORY ONLY, not a legal determination: 183+ days physically present in a tax year is commonly used as a resident-status guideline. Actual rules vary by country (tie-breaker tests, visa type, permanent home, center of vital interests, etc.) and this figure does not override your own judgment or professional advice.
